SliceOSM ontvangt alleen deze gebiedsgre: SliceOSM receives only this boundary and your IP address; your area name, GPX, times and edits stay local. The boundary is accessible through the download link. Free, no account. The service may log usage data.

Sla de GPX op en kies dit bestand daarna: Save the GPX, then select it on the upload page. It contains your route coordinates. Sign in at the service itself; RouteRefit stores no passwords and uploads nothing in the background.
Importeer als geplande route en kies het: Import as a planned route and choose to keep the original track. Save the route for navigation.
Kies Importeren bij Koersen. Selecteer d: Choose Import under Courses. Select the GPX, save the course and send it to your compatible Garmin device.
Gebruik de uploadknop in de routeplanner: Use Upload in the route builder, select the GPX and save the route. Strava may require a subscription.
Voor auto en motor heb je een GPX-geschi: For cars and motorcycles, use a road navigator supporting GPX. These sports services do not support every activity or device.

KML vereist minstens twee punten per rou: KML requires at least two points per section. Choose GPX or TCX for isolated points.
